mission: What tools, APIs, and capabilities should we build or adopt?
guiding_principle: SOP-023: Tools should ENABLE DOMAIN OUTPUT (market picks, research, data analysis), not more coordination infrastructure.

current_state_summary.observation: The repo is heavily weighted toward utility/infrastructure (27 utility scripts) vs domain-output tools (8 analysis, 16 data-collection). Only 2 actual API tools exist despite 44 cataloged sources. The gap between cataloged sources and usable tools is the primary bottleneck for domain output.

missing_tools_ranked.name: pick_logger
missing_tools_ranked.description: Structured logging of market research picks with entry price, thesis, confidence, and timestamps. Enables tracking pick performance over time.
missing_tools_ranked.recommendation: BUILD IMMEDIATELY. This is the single most domain-enabling missing tool. Without it, market picks are scattered across session logs with no structured tracking. Uses the existing market-research/picks/ directory and TEMPLATE.md. Estimated: 2-3 hours.

missing_tools_ranked.name: cost_tracker
missing_tools_ranked.description: Tracks API call costs and token usage across sessions. Essential for managing free-tier API rate limits and budgeting paid API usage for financial data.
missing_tools_ranked.recommendation: BUILD. Directly enables sustainable use of financial data APIs (Alpha Vantage 25 calls/day, Finnhub limits, etc.). Without cost awareness, teams will burn through free tiers. Estimated: 3-4 hours.

missing_tools_ranked.name: context_budget_monitor
missing_tools_ranked.description: Monitors context window usage to prevent truncation of critical domain data during analysis sessions.
missing_tools_ranked.recommendation: BUILD. When analyzing financial statements or large datasets, context overflow silently degrades output quality. This tool protects domain output quality. Estimated: 2-3 hours.

missing_tools_ranked.name: dedup_checker
missing_tools_ranked.description: Checks if a KB entry, finding, or pick already exists before creating duplicates.
missing_tools_ranked.recommendation: BUILD. We already have SCR-0041 (finding_dedup.py) for fuzzy matching. Extend it to work as a pre-creation check for KB entries and picks. Prevents redundant research. Estimated: 2 hours.

missing_tools_ranked.name: auto_briefing
missing_tools_ranked.description: Automatically generates briefing documents from recent session logs, KB entries, and market picks for new teams.
missing_tools_ranked.recommendation: DEFER. The MCP kb-search server already provides searchable access to all KB content. Auto-briefing is nice-to-have but the current onboarding prompt in the MCP repo server covers this. Focus on domain tools first.

missing_tools_ranked.name: session_planner
missing_tools_ranked.description: Plans session work based on prior team outputs, open handoff items, and repository health.
missing_tools_ranked.recommendation: DEFER. This is coordination infrastructure, not domain-enabling. The think_tank.py and multi_team_runner.py already coordinate sessions. Adding another planner adds complexity without domain output.

missing_tools_ranked.name: sop_consolidator
missing_tools_ranked.description: Merges and deduplicates SOPs that have accumulated (28+ SOPs).
missing_tools_ranked.recommendation: SKIP. Pure infrastructure housekeeping. Per SOP-023, this is exactly the kind of recursive coordination tool to avoid. SOPs can be manually reviewed.

missing_tools_ranked.name: trace_propagator
missing_tools_ranked.description: Propagates trace IDs across multi-agent coordination for debugging.
missing_tools_ranked.recommendation: SKIP. Pure debugging infrastructure. Only useful if coordination system has bugs, which is a sign of over-complexity, not under-tooling.

missing_tools_ranked.name: zombie_reclaimer
missing_tools_ranked.description: Reclaims resources from zombie agent processes.
missing_tools_ranked.recommendation: SKIP. The coordination system already has heartbeat monitoring in multi_team_runner.py. Building a separate zombie reclaimer is infrastructure recursion.

api_gaps_ranked.name: SEC EDGAR
api_gaps_ranked.recommendation: BUILD data-gathering tool immediately. SEC EDGAR provides free access to all public company financial filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K), XBRL financial data, and submission histories. This is THE foundational data source for any market pick. No authentication needed. Build method_sec_edgar.py following existing pattern.

api_gaps_ranked.name: FRED (Federal Reserve Economic Data)
api_gaps_ranked.recommendation: BUILD data-gathering tool. FRED has 820,000+ economic time series (GDP, unemployment, interest rates, inflation). Essential for macro analysis that contextualizes stock picks. Build method_fred.py.

api_gaps_ranked.name: Alpha Vantage
api_gaps_ranked.rate_limits: 25 calls/day (free tier, reduced from 500 in late 2024)
api_gaps_ranked.recommendation: BUILD data-gathering tool. Covers real-time stock prices, 50+ technical indicators, fundamental data. The 25 calls/day limit is restrictive but sufficient for targeted analysis. Build method_alphavantage.py. Consider also setting up the Alpha Vantage MCP server (official, free).

api_gaps_ranked.name: Finnhub
api_gaps_ranked.recommendation: BUILD data-gathering tool. Real-time stock data, company fundamentals, economic data, alternative data. More generous free tier than Alpha Vantage. Build method_finnhub.py.

api_gaps_ranked.name: CoinGecko
api_gaps_ranked.recommendation: BUILD if crypto analysis is in scope. Comprehensive crypto market data, historical prices, trending coins. Build method_coingecko.py.

api_gaps_ranked.name: Financial Modeling Prep (FMP)
api_gaps_ranked.recommendation: CATALOG and BUILD. Financial statements, DCF valuations, stock screener, earnings calendars. More generous free tier than Alpha Vantage. Excellent for fundamental analysis. Build method_fmp.py.

api_gaps_ranked.name: CrossRef
api_gaps_ranked.recommendation: BUILD data-gathering tool. Useful for academic research validation, but we already have OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar which overlap significantly. Lower priority than financial APIs.

api_gaps_ranked.name: PyPI/npm
api_gaps_ranked.recommendation: ALREADY COVERED by version_tracker.py (SCR-0047). No additional tool needed.

api_gaps_ranked.name: StackOverflow/StackExchange
api_gaps_ranked.recommendation: LOW PRIORITY. Useful for technical research but not domain-output enabling for market picks or financial analysis.

api_gaps_ranked.name: PubMed
api_gaps_ranked.recommendation: LOW PRIORITY. Biomedical/life sciences research. Only relevant for pharma stock analysis. We already have OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar for academic papers.

api_gaps_ranked.name: Reddit
api_gaps_ranked.rate_limits: Reddit API now requires paid access for most use cases (changed 2023)
api_gaps_ranked.recommendation: SKIP. Reddit API pricing changes in 2023 made it expensive. Sentiment data can be obtained via other sources (news APIs, HackerNews which we already have).

api_gaps_ranked.name: Hugging Face Hub
api_gaps_ranked.rate_limits: Generous for metadata, inference API has limits
api_gaps_ranked.recommendation: LOW PRIORITY. Useful for ML model discovery but not directly domain-enabling for market research.

api_gaps_ranked.name: ConceptNet
api_gaps_ranked.recommendation: SKIP. Common-sense knowledge graph. Not relevant to market research or financial analysis.

api_gaps_ranked.name: Open-Meteo
api_gaps_ranked.recommendation: SKIP. Weather data has minimal relevance to core market research mission.

new_techniques.name: LightRAG
new_techniques.description: Graph-enhanced RAG framework that builds a lightweight knowledge graph during ingestion. Entities become nodes, relationships become edges. Dual-level retrieval (specific entities + broader themes). Published at EMNLP 2025.
new_techniques.applicability: HIGH. Our knowledge base of 40+ KB entries with builds_on chains is a natural graph structure. LightRAG could dramatically improve KB retrieval by understanding entity relationships (tools -> APIs -> data sources -> picks). Would replace simple TF-IDF search (SCR-0018) with graph-aware retrieval.

new_techniques.name: MCP Financial Data Servers
new_techniques.source: Multiple vendors (Alpha Vantage, Financial Datasets, FMP, EODHD, Yahoo Finance/Stockflow)
new_techniques.description: Pre-built MCP servers that expose financial data as callable tools. Alpha Vantage has an official MCP server. Financial Datasets MCP supports OAuth (no API key needed for interactive use). Yahoo Finance Stockflow requires no auth at all.
new_techniques.applicability: CRITICAL. Instead of building custom data-gathering scripts for each financial API, we can add existing MCP servers to .mcp.json and immediately have financial data tools available. This is the single highest-leverage adoption opportunity.

new_techniques.name: Claude Agent SDK (agent-sdk)
new_techniques.description: Production agent runtime with built-in tools (Read, Write, Bash, Grep, Glob, WebFetch, WebSearch), MCP integration, Agent Skills (.skill.md), subagent spawning, and sandbox execution. Python v0.1.48, TypeScript v0.2.71.
new_techniques.applicability: HIGH. We are already running inside this SDK. Key underutilized capability: Agent Skills - we could package our market research workflow, data gathering pipeline, and pick analysis as reusable skills. Also: subagent spawning could replace our custom coordination system.

new_techniques.name: Agent Skills (agentskills.io)
new_techniques.description: Open standard published December 2025 for packaging agent capabilities as SKILL.md files. Works across Claude.ai, Claude Code, and Agent SDK. A skill is a directory with instructions, scripts, and reference material.
new_techniques.applicability: HIGH. We should package our key domain workflows as skills: market-research-pick, financial-analysis, data-gathering-pipeline. This makes our tools reusable outside this specific repo.

new_techniques.name: MCP Apps (Interactive UI Extension)
new_techniques.description: Official MCP extension (live 2026) where tools return interactive UI components: dashboards, forms, visualizations, multi-step workflows rendered directly in conversation.
new_techniques.applicability: MEDIUM. Could enable interactive stock screener dashboards, portfolio visualization, or pick performance charts rendered in conversation. Future-looking but worth monitoring.

new_techniques.name: GraphRAG / LazyGraphRAG
new_techniques.description: Full GraphRAG extracts entities/relationships from documents into hierarchical communities. LazyGraphRAG reduces indexing cost to 0.1% of full GraphRAG while maintaining quality.
new_techniques.applicability: MEDIUM. More heavyweight than LightRAG. LazyGraphRAG variant is interesting for large-scale document analysis but our corpus is small enough that LightRAG is more appropriate.

mcp_expansion.description: Official MCP server for stock market data, technical indicators, fundamentals. Uses Progressive Tool Discovery to minimize token usage.
Lightweight, no-auth financial data server. Real-time prices, historical data, company info.
mcp_expansion.install: npm package, add to .mcp.json, no API key needed

mcp_expansion.description: Income statements, balance sheets, cash flow, stock/crypto prices, SEC filings. OAuth for interactive, API key for programmatic.
Package our pick-making workflow as an Agent Skill: gather financial data -> analyze fundamentals -> check technicals -> generate pick with thesis -> log via pick_logger.
mcp_expansion.install: Create .skill.md in repo with workflow instructions

mcp_expansion.description: Wrap LightRAG graph-based retrieval as an MCP server for our knowledge base. Replace or augment current kb-search MCP server with graph-aware retrieval.
mcp_expansion.install: Build custom MCP server using LightRAG library + our KB corpus

build_vs_adopt.reasoning: Multiple production MCP servers already exist (Alpha Vantage, Yahoo Finance/Stockflow, FMP). Adding them to .mcp.json takes minutes. Building custom method_*.py scripts for each API is redundant when MCP servers provide the same data with better integration.

No MCP server exists for SEC EDGAR specifically. The API is free, no-auth, and critical for fundamental analysis. Build method_sec_edgar.py following our established pattern. Also consider the sec-api Python package.
No well-known MCP server for FRED. We have the source cataloged (SRC-0018/SRC-0039). Build method_fred.py - straightforward REST API with free key.
Domain-specific to our market-research workflow. No external tool exists for this. Build as a simple Python script that creates structured pick entries in market-research/picks/.
Needs to be integrated with our specific API usage patterns and free-tier limits. Simple wrapper around request_cache.py (SCR-0022) that counts calls per API per day.

LightRAG is mature (EMNLP 2025 publication, active development through Nov 2025). Building our own graph retrieval would be wasteful. Install LightRAG, index our KB corpus, and optionally wrap as MCP server.
Agent Skills are just .skill.md files with structured instructions. We need to create skills specific to our domain workflows. This is a content creation task, not a software development task.
SCR-0041 (finding_dedup.py) already does fuzzy matching. Extend it with a pre-creation check mode rather than building a new tool.
Simple token counting utility. No external tool fits our specific context window management needs.
Per SOP-023 anti-recursion protocol, these are infrastructure tools that do not enable domain output. They address coordination complexity that should be reduced, not managed.

top_5_recommendations.justification: Instant access to stock prices, fundamentals, and financial statements by adding 2-3 pre-built MCP servers (Alpha Vantage, Yahoo Finance/Stockflow, Financial Datasets). This is the highest-leverage action: minutes of configuration yields production-grade financial data tools. Enables market picks immediately.
specific_actions: Add Alpha Vantage MCP server (official, free API key)
Add Yahoo Finance Stockflow MCP (no auth needed)
Add Financial Datasets MCP (OAuth for interactive use)

top_5_recommendations.justification: SEC EDGAR is the only free, no-auth source of comprehensive US public company financial data. No MCP server exists for it. Every serious market pick requires fundamental analysis of financial statements (10-K, 10-Q). Build method_sec_edgar.py + catalog as SRC entry.
specific_actions: Extract XBRL financial data (revenue, earnings, etc.)

top_5_recommendations.justification: Without structured pick logging, market research output is scattered and untrackable. This tool closes the loop from research -> pick -> performance tracking. Uses existing market-research/picks/ infrastructure.
specific_actions: Build pick_logger.py that creates structured pick entries
Include: ticker, entry_price, thesis, confidence, date, data_sources_used

top_5_recommendations.justification: Macro-economic context (interest rates, GDP, unemployment, inflation) is essential for contextualizing stock picks. FRED has 820,000+ time series. Free API key, 120 req/min. No MCP server available.
specific_actions: Support series search and data retrieval
Key series: GDP, CPI, UNRATE, DFF, T10Y2Y (yield curve)

top_5_recommendations.item: Adopt LightRAG for knowledge graph retrieval
top_5_recommendations.justification: Our KB has 40+ entries with builds_on chains forming a natural graph. Current search is TF-IDF (SCR-0018) or FTS5 (MCP kb-search). LightRAG would enable relationship-aware queries like 'what tools relate to market research' by understanding entity connections. This improves the quality of briefings and prevents redundant work.
specific_actions: Index all KB entries, team logs, and script metadata
Build MCP server wrapper (or extend existing kb-search MCP)
Test with multi-hop queries across KB entries

anti_recommendations.item: Do NOT build sop_consolidator, trace_propagator, or zombie_reclaimer
anti_recommendations.reason: These are infrastructure-recursive tools. Per SOP-023, the coordination system should be simplified, not managed with more tools. If 28 SOPs are too many, delete some rather than building a tool to manage them.

anti_recommendations.item: Do NOT build a Reddit data-gathering tool
anti_recommendations.reason: Reddit API pricing changes (2023) make it expensive. Sentiment data is available through HackerNews (already built, SCR-0024) and news APIs.

anti_recommendations.item: Do NOT build custom financial data scripts when MCP servers exist
anti_recommendations.reason: Alpha Vantage, Yahoo Finance, and Financial Datasets all have production MCP servers. Using them via .mcp.json is faster and more reliable than building method_*.py scripts for the same APIs.

anti_recommendations.item: Do NOT pursue ConceptNet or Open-Meteo tools
anti_recommendations.reason: Neither is relevant to the core market research and financial analysis mission.

key_insight: The biggest gap is not in tools or infrastructure -- it is in the ratio of domain-output tools to coordination tools. We have 54 scripts but only 2 API tools and zero financial data integrations usable in real-time. Adding 2-3 financial MCP servers to .mcp.json would instantly transform our capability to produce market picks, taking us from 'can research topics' to 'can analyze stocks with real financial data' in hours, not weeks.
